g.text: Shaded feasible polygon satisfies x+y≤4,x≤2,y≤3 and nonnegativity. Objective line3x+2y=10 supports the optimum at(2,2); moving it parallel toward larger
profit eventually leaves the feasible set. The model is continuous and bounded. Corner enumeration verifies this particular two-variable optimum, not every
